cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(AcyclicInstalledRpcConsumer LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(AcyclicTransport 0.2.0 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_executable(RpcConsumer rpc_consumer.cc)
target_compile_features(RpcConsumer PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(RpcConsumer PRIVATE Acyclic::Transport)
foreach(CONTROL PositiveTypes InvalidActorBytes InvalidWorkerBytes InvalidOptionalInteger)
  add_library(${CONTROL} OBJECT EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ${CONTROL}.cc)
  target_compile_features(${CONTROL} PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_link_libraries(${CONTROL} PRIVATE Acyclic::Transport)
endforeach()
